title: Plan-First Coherent Draft

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after this locally verified release is pushed.

ciDeep.note: Broader multi-course and independent-instructor evaluation remains research evidence, not a claim of this release.

deploy.note: Production deployment is downstream of the successful push and remote fast verification.

liveProvider.note: A fresh representative package is bound by SHA-256 and render-audited locally; the live deployed build remains pending.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, accessibility certification, or classroom validation is claimed.

claims.summary: Instructional intent is prepared and admitted before package drafting.
Governing course materials, policies, workload, and grading survive source recovery and compilation.
Semantic claims and structural receipts are verified without treating one as the other.
A fresh representative package passes export, render, and deterministic conformance checks.

boundaries: This contract records a locally verified predeploy release; remote CI and deployment are still downstream facts.
A deterministic score, replay package, structural accessibility audit, or visual polish does not prove teaching quality.
The representative export is bounded evidence and does not prove universal course quality.
Remote CI, deployment, instructor review, accessibility certification, and classroom outcomes remain separate.
